messages:
mira: heads up — Next/Edge sample broke on Vercel after we moved to pnpm (isolated linker). Node builds fine, edge build errors: 'Package \"@redwood/sdk\" has no export named \"./runtime/edge\"'.

sam: that usually means the bundler resolves the package file path under .pnpm/ and then subpath exports aren't applied because of symlinked layout. esbuild is picky here.

joel: two quick fixes we use: 1) add a tiny root proxy file (runtime-edge.js) that re-exports the built runtime and expose it via exports as './runtime-edge', or 2) set pnpm node-linker=hoisted so packages are flattened and exports work normally.

mira: tried hoisted locally — build succeeds. But we shouldn't force customers to change linker. I'll add the proxy in the example app and a short note in README.

tia: also add troubleshooting snippet to devex docs. include these commands to repro and debug:

```bash
pnpm i
cd apps/web
pnpm run build # triggers esbuild error
node -e "console.log(require.resolve('@redwood/sdk/package.json'))"
# try hoisted mode
echo 'node-linker=hoisted' > .npmrc
pnpm install --force
pnpm --filter apps/web run build
```

sam: opened PR that switches sample import to '@redwood/sdk/runtime-edge' (proxy) and adds README note. ci-bot: ran preview builds with default and hoisted pnpm; both green. :white_check_mark:

mira: thanks — will follow up with an Issue to add CI matrix for pnpm/yarn/turborepo and doc section for "monorepo exports gotchas".
